decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a cheap accessory that complements the firm's track lighting system, so keeping it open costs little and it supports the core range even though evidence after 2018 is lacking.

This single LED luminaire got only a passing mention and no confirmed later results, but it costs little to keep listed, and by 2022 the newer 2019 LED families may supersede it, so the risk of dropping is moderate.

The home automation server box lies outside the firm's core luminaire business and faces fast technological change and strong platform competitors, which makes abandonment fairly likely, but with no clear negative signal the cheap option is kept open for now.
The luminaire family had a dedicated page, which signals a bigger commitment and a fit with the core business, so it is likely kept as a platform for further variants.
